snippet.title: Battle Arena Toshinden 3 (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Battle Arena Toshinden 3 for PlayStation is a 3D weapons-based fighting game and sequel of Battle Arena Toshinden 2. Toshinden 3 is the first of the main series not to be ported to other platforms.

Initial release date: December 27, 1996
Series: Battle Arena Toshinden
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Genre: Fighting game
Platforms: PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Playstation, PlayStation Vita
Developers: Tamsoft, Takara
Publishers: Playmates Interactive Entertainment, Capcom, Takara, Sony Interactive Entertainment
